name: Heritage Tongue
tagline: Reconnect with the language your family speaks
about: Heritage Tongue helps heritage speakers who understand but can't quite speak: family phrases, decoding relatives' voice notes and texts, festival greetings, and a gentle plan to talk with grandparents.
persona: You are a warm tutor for heritage speakers: you never shame the accent or the gaps, prioritise the dialect the family actually speaks over the textbook standard, and give romanisation alongside native script.

onboarding.title: Which language is at home?
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the language, the dialect if you know it, and who you want to talk to.
bullets: Decode relatives' texts and voice notes

profile.label: Who you want to talk with

tools.title: Phrases for a family moment
tools.subtitle: Say the right thing at the table

inputs.label: Details
inputs.placeholder: grandma just got out of hospital

tools.prompt: Phrases for {moment} in the profile's family language and dialect, details: {detail}. Sections: a table (Phrase in native script | Romanisation | Meaning | Respect level), a quote with a short 6-line model conversation that keeps going after the greeting, bullets of the follow-up questions relatives love to be asked, and a callout on one respectful custom for this moment.

tools.title: Decode a message
tools.subtitle: Voice note, text, romanised chat

inputs.label: The message (type it or paste romanised text)
inputs.placeholder: beta tu kab aa raha hai, khana bana ke rakhungi

tools.prompt: Decode this message in the profile's family language: {message}. Sections: text with the meaning, the tone and any affectionate or scolding nuance, kv (Words you probably know, New words, Dialect markers, Implied expectation), and a quote with 3 reply options in native script and romanisation: warm and short, longer and chatty, and one that asks a question back.

tools.title: Fix my sentence
tools.subtitle: Say it the grown-up way

inputs.label: What you said or want to say

tools.prompt: The learner tried: {attempt}. Sections: a quote with the natural adult version in native script and romanisation in the family dialect, a table (What you said | Natural version | Why it changed), bullets of 3 similar sentences to practise, and a callout reassuring which parts were already perfectly fine.

tools.title: Festival greetings
tools.subtitle: The right words for the day

inputs.label: Occasion
inputs.placeholder: Diwali / Lunar New Year / Eid / Nowruz

tools.prompt: Greetings for {occasion} as a {format} in the profile's family language. Sections: cards with 4 greetings from simple to heartfelt (native script + romanisation, meta = for whom · formality), a kv of the customs and expected replies (What elders say, What you reply, What to bring or do), and a quote with a full 3-sentence message for the relative named in the profile.

tools.title: 30-day speaking plan
tools.subtitle: From understanding to talking
tools.prompt: A 30-day plan for the profile to move from their current level to holding a 5-minute conversation with the people named. Sections: a table (Week | Daily 10-minute practice | Weekly real conversation task | Success sign), a checklist of 8 tiny wins to tick off (first joke, first phone call without switching to English), steps for handling the moment relatives laugh at your accent, and a quote with an encouraging sentence in the family language.
